fields.statement: Verifier at d05f25d34: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run TestRunMilestoneCheckEnforcesNumber -count=1 -v passes. The test starts plan-milestone runs with MilestoneNumber 7 and calls run.milestone-check through the API registry. It passes for milestone-7 with field milestone=7 and done point m7-first. It fails for handle milestone-8, for field milestone=8, and for unprefixed done point "first". Each error names the intent, contains "milestone number 7" and has a Fix line that names milestone-7, milestone=7 and the m7- prefix. The full internal/api package run printed PASS for every test, then the root-state guard reported .rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed. That file is written by the live root, not by this diff. go vet and gofmt are clean. In the diff (newMilestoneNumberProblems), only new intents that carry a milestone field (absent from the landed disk model) are checked, and only when the run reserved a number.
